query: set up a github action that runs my nebius job on every push to main
expected_behavior: Uses non-interactive service-account-key auth (nebius profile create --service-account-file-path from a CI secret), never a browser login
Reads the credentials from the CI secret store into a temp file with 0600 perms; never echoes or logs the key material
Puts a nebius ai job create --dry-run step before the real submit so a bad spec fails the build cheaply
Uses a deterministic job name (e.g. ci-<sha>) and an explicit --timeout
Does not have the agent generate the SA key or run iam get-access-token — those are human/CI steps
